The strongest candidates are repeat offenders rather than new listings. I’m ranking by hit probability × conditional funding depth, so a coin with a history of prolonged, extreme episodes can outrank a warmer coin likely to make only a shallow touch.

Probabilities are anchored to the 9.5% quiet-universe baseline and roughly 27–34% repeat-offender baselines, with adjustments for current pressure. Pair-removal announcements are treated as possible arbitrage frictions—not proof that all spot trading or borrowing has stopped.
